_about: The games bundled with Pocket Arcade. Every one is free software or freely licensed: licence checked in its own repository on 2026-11-23. rom: the file from Homebrew Hub (gbdev/database). shot: the harness frame used as the preview. Order here is the order in the app. palette: the colours an original Game Boy game starts in (app/emu.c emu_palettes: 2 Solana, 3 Arcade, 4 Sunset, 5 Night); the preview is rendered in them. dmg: a Color-compatible game whose own colours are green, run as an original Game Boy so it takes the palette.
